content.json:
# Azure resource discovery

Resource inventory, regional distribution, service configurations, and backup protection across selected subscriptions.

parameters.label: Source regions
parameters.name: SourceRegions
parameters.query: Resources | where isnotempty(location) | project value = tolower(location), label = tolower(location) | distinct value, label | order by label asc

parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.query: Resources | where isnotempty(resourceGroup) | project value = resourceGroup, label = resourceGroup | distinct value, label | order by label asc

parameters.name: View
parameters.jsonData: [{"selected":true,"value":"Discovery","label":"Discovery"},{"selected":false,"value":"Paired region specific services","label":"Paired region specific services"}]
parameters.label: View

parameters.name: Evidence
parameters.jsonData: [{"selected":true,"value":"All","label":"All"},{"selected":false,"value":"Detected configuration","label":"Detected configuration"},{"selected":false,"value":"Documented service behavior","label":"Documented service behavior"},{"selected":false,"value":"Needs verification","label":"Needs verification"}]
parameters.label: Evidence (paired-region view only)

content.json:
## Discovery

All indexed resource types in the selected subscription, source-region, and resource-group scope. Global and unlocated resources are retained. Location is resource metadata, not a complete map of replicas or dependencies.

**Detail limit: 1,000 rows.** Counts are calculated before the cap; larger inventories require narrower subscription or resource-group scopes. Access and indexing gaps can still apply.

content.query:
Resources
| where '*' in ({SourceRegions}) or location in~ ({SourceRegions}) or isempty(location) or location =~ 'global'
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| summarize IndexedResources = count()
| extend DetailStatus = iff(IndexedResources > 1000, 'TRUNCATED: narrow subscriptions / resource groups before export', 'Within 1000-row detail cap; access and indexing gaps still apply')
content.noDataMessage: No indexed rows match this scope. Check subscription access and filters. Resource Graph may not index every resource or configuration.
content.title: Resource inventory counts

content.json:
## Paired region specific services

Storage, Backup vaults, SQL, Key Vault, and PostgreSQL/MySQL services with paired-region features or service-managed replication. Inclusion does not prove that geo-redundancy is enabled. SQL and PostgreSQL/MySQL replicas can use customer-selected regions independently of backup pairing; Key Vault has regional exceptions.

Missing properties and unindexed relationships require verification; they do not prove a feature is disabled. Counts precede the **1,000-row** detail cap. The planned target region does not validate service availability or recovery access.

**Paired configuration detected** refers only to observed paired-region settings. **Not detected - verify** is not proof of a disabled feature. Evidence can report a detected read replica even when paired geo-backups are not detected.

content.query:
Resources
| extend resourceType = tolower(type), resourceLocation = tolower(location)
| where resourceLocation in~ ({SourceRegions}) or '*' in ({SourceRegions})
    or isempty(resourceLocation) or resourceLocation == 'global'
    or (resourceType == 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts' and replace_string(tolower(tostring(properties.locations)), ' ', '') has_any ({SourceRegions}))
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| extend service = case(
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'Storage',
    resourceType in ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults'), 'Backup',
    resourceType in ('microsoft.sql/servers', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases', 'microsoft.sql/managedinstances'), 'SQL',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults', 'Key Vault',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.documentdb/databaseaccounts', 'Cosmos DB',
    resourceType in ('microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.dbformysql/flexibleservers'), 'PostgreSQL / MySQL',
    resourceType in ('microsoft.eventhub/namespaces', 'microsoft.servicebus/namespaces'), 'Messaging',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.containerregistry/registries', 'Container Registry',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.apimanagement/service', 'API Management',
    'Outside automated coverage')
| where service != 'Outside automated coverage'
| where '{Service}' == 'All' or service == '{Service}'
| extend storageSku = tostring(sku.name),
    currentSqlBackup = tostring(properties.currentBackupStorageRedundancy),
    requestedSqlBackup = tostring(properties.requestedBackupStorageRedundancy),
    recoveryVaultRedundancy = tostring(properties.redundancySettings.standardTierStorageRedundancy),
    recoveryVaultCrr = tostring(properties.redundancySettings.crossRegionRestore),
    backupVaultStorage = tostring(properties.storageSettings),
    backupVaultCrr = tostring(properties.featureSettings.crossRegionRestoreSettings.state),
    flexibleGeoBackup = tostring(properties.backup.geoRedundantBackup),
    flexibleReplicaRole = tostring(properties.replicationRole),
    flexibleSource = tostring(properties.sourceServerResourceId)
| extend detected = case(
    service == 'Storage', storageSku in~ ('Standard_GRS', 'Standard_RAGRS', 'Standard_GZRS', 'Standard_RAGZRS'),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', recoveryVaultRedundancy =~ 'GeoRedundant' or recoveryVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', backupVaultStorage contains '"GeoRedundant"' or backupVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled',
    service == 'SQL', currentSqlBackup in~ ('Geo', 'GeoZone'),
    service == 'Cosmos DB', array_length(properties.locations) > 1,
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', flexibleGeoBackup =~ 'Enabled' or isnotempty(flexibleSource) or flexibleReplicaRole in~ ('Replica', 'AsyncReplica', 'GeoAsyncReplica'),
    service == 'Messaging', array_length(properties.geoDataReplication.locations) > 1,
    service == 'API Management', array_length(properties.additionalLocations) > 0,
    false)
| extend evidence = case(
    detected, 'Detected configuration',
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Documented service behavior',
    'Needs verification')
| where '{Evidence}' == 'All' or evidence == '{Evidence}'
| extend pairedConfigurationDetected = case(
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Not exposed - service-managed',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', iff(flexibleGeoBackup =~ 'Enabled', 'Yes', 'Not detected - verify'),
    service in ('Storage', 'Backup', 'SQL'), iff(detected, 'Yes', 'Not detected - verify'),
    'Not applicable')
| extend pairedRegionConfiguration = case(
    service == 'Storage', case(
        storageSku =~ 'Standard_GRS', 'GRS',
        storageSku =~ 'Standard_RAGRS', 'RA-GRS',
        storageSku =~ 'Standard_GZRS', 'GZRS',
        storageSku =~ 'Standard_RAGZRS', 'RA-GZRS',
        'GRS / RA-GRS / GZRS / RA-GZRS (not detected)'),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', case(
        recoveryVaultRedundancy =~ 'GeoRedundant' and recoveryVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backup storage + Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        recoveryVaultRedundancy =~ 'GeoRedundant', 'Geo-redundant backup storage',
        recoveryVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        'Geo-redundant backup storage / CRR (not detected)'),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', case(
        backupVaultStorage contains '"GeoRedundant"' and backupVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backup storage + Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        backupVaultStorage contains '"GeoRedundant"', 'Geo-redundant backup storage',
        backupVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        'Geo-redundant backup storage / CRR (not detected)'),
    service == 'SQL', case(
        currentSqlBackup =~ 'Geo', 'Geo-redundant backups (Geo / GRS)',
        currentSqlBackup =~ 'GeoZone', 'Geo-zone-redundant backups (GeoZone / GZRS)',
        'Geo / GeoZone backup redundancy (not detected)'),
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Service-managed replication (regional exceptions; no customer setting)',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', iff(flexibleGeoBackup =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backups', 'Geo-redundant backups (not detected; read replicas are separate)'),
    'No fixed region-pair configuration identified')
| extend pairingModel = case(
    service == 'Storage', 'Fixed pair for GRS / GZRS',
    service == 'Backup', 'Paired backup replication; workload-specific CRR',
    service == 'SQL', 'Paired geo-backups; customer-selected SQL replicas',
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Service-managed replication; regional exceptions',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', 'Paired geo-backups; separate replica topology',
    'Customer-selected regions / configuration')
| extend observedConfiguration = case(
    service == 'Storage', strcat('sku=', storageSku, '; primary=', tostring(properties.primaryLocation), '; secondary=', tostring(properties.secondaryLocation), '; secondaryStatus=', tostring(properties.statusOfSecondary)),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', strcat('redundancy=', recoveryVaultRedundancy, '; CRR=', recoveryVaultCrr),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', strcat('storageSettings=', backupVaultStorage, '; CRR=', backupVaultCrr, '; replicatedRegions=', tostring(properties.replicatedRegions)),
    service == 'SQL', strcat('currentBackup=', currentSqlBackup, '; requestedBackup=', requestedSqlBackup, '; zoneRedundant=', tostring(properties.zoneRedundant), '; DB role=', tostring(properties.secondaryType), '; failover groups / replication links REQUIRE service API'),
    service == 'Key Vault', 'No customer-configured replication flag. Verify current Key Vault reliability guidance; do not apply this rule to Managed HSM.',
    service == 'Cosmos DB', strcat('locations=', tostring(properties.locations), '; failoverOrder=', tostring(properties.failoverPolicies), '; automaticFailover=', tostring(properties.enableAutomaticFailover), '; multiWrite=', tostring(properties.enableMultipleWriteLocations)),
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', strcat('geoBackup=', flexibleGeoBackup, '; replicaRole=', flexibleReplicaRole, '; sourceServer=', flexibleSource, '; HA=', tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode)),
    service == 'Messaging', strcat('geoDataReplication=', tostring(properties.geoDataReplication), '; Geo-DR alias and partner REQUIRE service API'),
    service == 'API Management', strcat('additionalLocations=', tostring(properties.additionalLocations), '; sku=', storageSku),
    'Registry replication child resources REQUIRE service API; resource existence does not prove geo-replication.')
| extend nextAction = case(
    service == 'Storage', 'Verify observed secondary, replication lag, endpoints, encryption, immutability and copy/cutover method. The paired secondary cannot be freely selected.',
    service == 'Backup', 'Read vault redundancy/CRR via service API; inventory protected items and recovery points. Validate target workload support, restore access, retention and protection gap.',
    service == 'SQL', 'Enumerate failover groups and every database replication link; verify current vs requested backup redundancy, partner subscriptions, listeners, TDE keys and target compatibility.',
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Confirm failover limitations and key/secret continuity; validate subscription/geography restore constraints and private endpoints.',
    service == 'Cosmos DB', 'Inspect ALL configured locations, write region, failover priorities, consistency, SDK preferred regions and replica transition.',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', 'Verify geo-backup create-time constraints, restore destinations, replicas, extension/version parity and application reconnection.',
    service == 'Messaging', 'Identify metadata-only Geo-DR vs data replication; check messages/events, offsets, identities, network rules, aliases and promotion semantics.',
    service == 'API Management', 'Verify SKU-specific multi-region support, gateway locations, certificates, backends and shared dependencies.',
    'Enumerate registry replications and verify target support, image availability, pull access and private endpoints.')
| project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, service, resourceType,
    evidence, pairedConfigurationDetected, pairedRegionConfiguration, pairingModel, observedConfiguration, nextAction
| where service in ('Storage', 'Backup', 'SQL', 'Key Vault', 'PostgreSQL / MySQL')
| summarize MatchingResources = count(), Detected = countif(evidence == 'Detected configuration'), DocumentedBehavior = countif(evidence == 'Documented service behavior'), NeedsVerification = countif(evidence == 'Needs verification')
| extend DetailStatus = iff(MatchingResources > 1000, 'TRUNCATED: narrow subscriptions/resource groups and reconcile all partitions', 'Within 1000-row detail cap; access and indexing gaps still apply')
content.noDataMessage: No indexed rows match this scope. Check subscription access and filters. Resource Graph may not index every resource or configuration.

        recoveryVaultRedundancy =~ 'GeoRedundant' and recoveryVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backup storage + Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        recoveryVaultRedundancy =~ 'GeoRedundant', 'Geo-redundant backup storage',
        recoveryVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        'Geo-redundant backup storage / CRR (not detected)'),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', case(
        backupVaultStorage contains '"GeoRedundant"' and backupVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backup storage + Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        backupVaultStorage contains '"GeoRedundant"', 'Geo-redundant backup storage',
        backupVaultCrr =~ 'Enabled', 'Cross Region Restore (CRR)',
        'Geo-redundant backup storage / CRR (not detected)'),
    service == 'SQL', case(
        currentSqlBackup =~ 'Geo', 'Geo-redundant backups (Geo / GRS)',
        currentSqlBackup =~ 'GeoZone', 'Geo-zone-redundant backups (GeoZone / GZRS)',
        'Geo / GeoZone backup redundancy (not detected)'),
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Service-managed replication (regional exceptions; no customer setting)',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', iff(flexibleGeoBackup =~ 'Enabled', 'Geo-redundant backups', 'Geo-redundant backups (not detected; read replicas are separate)'),
    'No fixed region-pair configuration identified')
| extend pairingModel = case(
    service == 'Storage', 'Fixed pair for GRS / GZRS',
    service == 'Backup', 'Paired backup replication; workload-specific CRR',
    service == 'SQL', 'Paired geo-backups; customer-selected SQL replicas',
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Service-managed replication; regional exceptions',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', 'Paired geo-backups; separate replica topology',
    'Customer-selected regions / configuration')
| extend observedConfiguration = case(
    service == 'Storage', strcat('sku=', storageSku, '; primary=', tostring(properties.primaryLocation), '; secondary=', tostring(properties.secondaryLocation), '; secondaryStatus=', tostring(properties.statusOfSecondary)),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', strcat('redundancy=', recoveryVaultRedundancy, '; CRR=', recoveryVaultCrr),
    resourceType == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults', strcat('storageSettings=', backupVaultStorage, '; CRR=', backupVaultCrr, '; replicatedRegions=', tostring(properties.replicatedRegions)),
    service == 'SQL', strcat('currentBackup=', currentSqlBackup, '; requestedBackup=', requestedSqlBackup, '; zoneRedundant=', tostring(properties.zoneRedundant), '; DB role=', tostring(properties.secondaryType), '; failover groups / replication links REQUIRE service API'),
    service == 'Key Vault', 'No customer-configured replication flag. Verify current Key Vault reliability guidance; do not apply this rule to Managed HSM.',
    service == 'Cosmos DB', strcat('locations=', tostring(properties.locations), '; failoverOrder=', tostring(properties.failoverPolicies), '; automaticFailover=', tostring(properties.enableAutomaticFailover), '; multiWrite=', tostring(properties.enableMultipleWriteLocations)),
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', strcat('geoBackup=', flexibleGeoBackup, '; replicaRole=', flexibleReplicaRole, '; sourceServer=', flexibleSource, '; HA=', tostring(properties.highAvailability.mode)),
    service == 'Messaging', strcat('geoDataReplication=', tostring(properties.geoDataReplication), '; Geo-DR alias and partner REQUIRE service API'),
    service == 'API Management', strcat('additionalLocations=', tostring(properties.additionalLocations), '; sku=', storageSku),
    'Registry replication child resources REQUIRE service API; resource existence does not prove geo-replication.')
| extend nextAction = case(
    service == 'Storage', 'Verify observed secondary, replication lag, endpoints, encryption, immutability and copy/cutover method. The paired secondary cannot be freely selected.',
    service == 'Backup', 'Read vault redundancy/CRR via service API; inventory protected items and recovery points. Validate target workload support, restore access, retention and protection gap.',
    service == 'SQL', 'Enumerate failover groups and every database replication link; verify current vs requested backup redundancy, partner subscriptions, listeners, TDE keys and target compatibility.',
    service == 'Key Vault', 'Confirm failover limitations and key/secret continuity; validate subscription/geography restore constraints and private endpoints.',
    service == 'Cosmos DB', 'Inspect ALL configured locations, write region, failover priorities, consistency, SDK preferred regions and replica transition.',
    service == 'PostgreSQL / MySQL', 'Verify geo-backup create-time constraints, restore destinations, replicas, extension/version parity and application reconnection.',
    service == 'Messaging', 'Identify metadata-only Geo-DR vs data replication; check messages/events, offsets, identities, network rules, aliases and promotion semantics.',
    service == 'API Management', 'Verify SKU-specific multi-region support, gateway locations, certificates, backends and shared dependencies.',
    'Enumerate registry replications and verify target support, image availability, pull access and private endpoints.')
| project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, service, resourceType,
    evidence, pairedConfigurationDetected, pairedRegionConfiguration, pairingModel, observedConfiguration, nextAction
| where service in ('Storage', 'Backup', 'SQL', 'Key Vault', 'PostgreSQL / MySQL')
| order by id asc | limit 1000

content.json:
## Backup and ASR

Protected items and replication targets in the selected subscription, source-region, and resource-group scope. Service/Evidence filters do not apply. Region screening uses vault and indexed ASR source/recovery regions; missing vault locations are retained.

A vault may protect workloads in other regions. These rows do not prove geo-redundancy or successful restore. Blank fields require service-level verification. **Detail limit: 1,000 rows.**

content.query:
RecoveryServicesResources
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems',
    'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupinstances',
    'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/replicationfabrics/replicationprotectioncontainers/replicationprotecteditems')
| extend vaultId = tolower(case(
    tolower(id) contains '/backupfabrics/', tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backupfabrics/')[0]),
    tolower(id) contains '/backupinstances/', tostring(split(tolower(id), '/backupinstances/')[0]),
    tostring(split(tolower(id), '/replicationfabrics/')[0])))
| extend protectionKind = iff(tolower(type) contains '/replicationprotecteditems', 'Site Recovery', 'Backup')
| join kind=leftouter (
    Resources
    | where type in~ ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults')
    | project vaultId = tolower(id), vaultName = name, vaultLocation = tolower(location)
    ) on vaultId
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroups}) or resourceGroup in~ ({ResourceGroups})
| where '*' in ({SourceRegions}) or vaultLocation in~ ({SourceRegions}) or isempty(vaultLocation)
    or tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.primaryFabricLocation) in~ ({SourceRegions})
    or tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.recoveryFabricLocation) in~ ({SourceRegions})
| project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, protectionKind, vaultName, vaultLocation,
    sourceResource = coalesce(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId), tostring(properties.dataSourceInfo.resourceID), tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.fabricObjectId)),
    policyId = coalesce(tostring(properties.policyId), tostring(properties.policyInfo.policyId)),
    protectionState = coalesce(tostring(properties.protectionState), tostring(properties.currentProtectionState)),
    lastBackupTime = tostring(properties.lastBackupTime),
    replicationHealth = tostring(properties.replicationHealth),
    sourceRegion = tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.primaryFabricLocation),
    recoveryRegion = tostring(properties.providerSpecificDetails.recoveryFabricLocation)
| summarize MatchingItems = count() | extend DetailStatus = iff(MatchingItems > 1000, 'TRUNCATED: partition by subscription / vault resource group', 'Within detail cap; reconcile service inventory')
